question: If the radius of a hemispherical balloon increases from 4 cm to 7 cm as air is pumped into it, find the ratio of the surface area of the new balloon to its original.
solution:
Given:

Radius r1​ = 4 cm

Radius r2 ​= 7 cm

Formula used:

The surface area of a hemisphere = 3πr2

Calculation:

Initial surface area (r1​ = 4) = 3πr12

⇒ 3 × (22/7)​ × 16

⇒ (1056/7) cm2

New surface area (r2​ = 7) = 3πr22

⇒ 3 × (22/7)​ × 49

⇒ (3234/7) cm2

Ratio of surface area = (3234/7) cm2 : (1056/7) cm2

⇒ 49 : 16

∴ Required ratio is 49 : 16

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
